Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"documents\":[\"Python is a programming language.\",\"Cats are cute animals.\",\"Python was created by Guido van Rossum.\",\"The sun is a star.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is Python?\",\"top_n\":2}", RerankRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.rerank(request)
    println(result)
}

```
